title: Water Sampling and Plating Generations (Antimicrobial Group)
author: Melissa B Duhaime
materials: Fully remove filter and resuspend pellet
Select a plate of the same media.

steps.title: Collect water samples
steps.instruction: Collect whole water samples from six sites using specific equipment based on depth.

substeps.instruction: Use a Van Dorn water collector for deep samples (~122.5-123.7 m).
Use 2 L containers for surface samples (~15 cm below the surface).

steps.title: Filter water samples
steps.instruction: Process the whole water samples to separate particle-associated and free-living fractions.

substeps.instruction: Prefilter whole water using a 20μm mesh.
Set up a peristaltic pump with a 3 µm filter.
Collect the <3μm filtered water as the free-living (FL) smaller fraction.

steps.title: Prepare particle-associated (PA) fraction
steps.instruction: Isolate and process the particle-associated large fragment from the filter.

substeps.instruction: Collect the filter in an eppendorf with 1mL of PBS.
Vortex the tube, then partially remove the filter with an edge under the closed cap.

steps.title: Plate parent generation
steps.instruction: Inoculate the PA and FL fractions onto agar plates to create the parent generation.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 10μL of both PA and FL onto separate plates of 4 agar types: TSA, LB, BG11, and LAKE.
Spread the inoculum on the plates.

steps.title: Isolate colonies and generate lineages
steps.instruction: Perform sequential streaking to isolate single colonies through three generations.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a single colony from the initial lawns using a sterile loop.
Streak for isolation using a three phase streak pattern, sterilizing the loop between each quadrant.
Repeat the process until generation 3 is obtained.
